user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 24 ℃ 到 26 ℃
二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 10%
期望 声音 处于 30 dB 到 45 dB
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 26 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 24 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 10 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 45 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_low_volume() X_stereo
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 30 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_high_volume() X_stereo
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_diffuser
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() X_stereo
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_diffuser
